verdict.rationale: Auth0 Organizations is a first-party feature for modeling B2B customers in a single tenant. It covers membership management, per-organization branding, connections and federated login flows. Self-serve customer-admin tooling (My Organization API, pre-built components) adds to it. Invitation flows are not explicitly described in the evidence (the docs snippet truncates after 'members, and'). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of invitation flows, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Organizations model.
